doc.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Extra Special Edition with Bobby McFerrin
summary: A 1994 experimental Special Edition record with guests Paul Grassi and McFerrin.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Well, as long as we’ve broken with the timeline/chronology… I want to return to this one called Extra Special Edition, 1994.
I think this is the last if not the penultimate release that reflects the Special Edition. Extra Special Edition… What are we saying here?

Extra Special Edition was extra because another friend of mine who played percussion named Paul Grassi was on a few tracks, and Bobby McFerrin came in and sang on a few tracks. A lot of that was open-ended improvisation that was co-written by us all. Bobby just came in and we went for it and I came up with the titles. There were a few things like “Rituals Of Spring” is on that. “Seventh D.” That’s a piece that appears

It’s an altered blues. Then some few things, “Speaking In Tongues,” a few things like that. That was more or less an experimental situation. Also, Greg Osby had gone from the band and Marvin Sewell was on guitar, (a) very wonderful guitarist who has done a lot of good things on his own and with Cassandra Wilson, great composer and a very different, unusual talent, gifted composer and player.
